tagline: 宾得数码单反相机，2008 年发布
description: 宾得于2008年推出的数码单反相机。配备Interchangeable Pentax KAF2 mount compatible with Pentax auto-aperture lenses; older lenses supported in stop-down metering mode.。快门速度1/4000 s – 30 s, Bulb。

specs.传感器: CMOS active pixel sensor with a primary color filter
specs.镜头: Interchangeable Pentax KAF2 mount compatible with Pentax auto-aperture lenses; older lenses supported in stop-down metering mode.
specs.曝光测光: TTL open-aperture metering with choice of: 16-segment, center-weighted & spot meter
specs.电池: Rechargeable D-LI50 Lithium-ion battery, Optional AC adapter
